existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `PractitionerRole` has hard local breaking changes in contact and availability serialization. Top migration concerns are transforming `telecom` to `contact.telecom`, transforming old schedule fields into `availability`, and preserving R6-only directory data when round-tripping to R4. Confidence is high for element-shape changes and lower for terminology-expansion details.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is mostly structural. Existing R4 instances with `telecom`, `availableTime`, `notAvailable`, or `availabilityExceptions` need explicit field-name and datatype transforms before R6 validation. R6-to-R4 conversion is lossy for richer `ExtendedContactDetail`, `Availability.period`, optional description-less `notAvailableTime`, and new directory metadata such as `network`, `display`, `characteristic`, and `communication` unless extensions are used.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local StructureDefinition element presence, cardinality, type, reference target, binding-strength, modifier, and summary flag comparisons because both core JSON StructureDefinitions were available. Confidence is medium for terminology content and rationale because no official diff/change note or terminology-server expansion was available.
